documents.title: Control mechanisms age
documents.body:
## Claim
Specific control mechanisms can become unnecessary as the underlying system improves.

## Evidence
In the synthetic test service, a parser upgrade removed the need for a syntax-repair retry. [Experiment](https://example.test/experiment#parser).

documents.title: The control role can remain
documents.body:
## Claim
The concrete syntax-repair retry is obsolete; validating the result remains necessary. Evaluate the mechanism and its role separately.

## Evidence
[Original observation](./controls.md#Claim). The synthetic experiment still required output validation.

documents.title: Room temperature controls
documents.body:
## Claim
This room's temperature controller has a physical manual override. [Manual](https://example.test/manual#override).

documents.title: An untested hypothesis
documents.body:
## Question
Could all validation become unnecessary? No observation or experiment supports this hypothesis yet.

documents.title: Another untested impression
documents.body:
## Question
Perhaps validation disappears with enough system improvements. This is an impression, not an established result.
